message.content: This is a cinematic "overture" landing screen for LOOMGUARD, with the headline "Every brand is a fabric." and gold italic subhead "One thread can unravel it." over a dark background of wavy thread-like lines. Supporting text describes "A governance film in three acts," plus a stat line "27 ASSETS PUBLISHED WORLDWIDE SINCE YOU ARRIVED," a "SCROLL" hint, a timeline with dots along the bottom, and a "SKIP → PRODUCT" link at bottom right. No mouse cursor is visible, and there are no rendering glitches or broken layout—the design is clean and polished.
